title: Firebase Auth returns auth/invalid-credential instead of auth/user-not-found or auth/wrong-password
symptoms: FirebaseError: Firebase: Error (auth/invalid-credential) for both unknown emails and wrong passwords
fetchSignInMethodsForEmail always returns an empty array
Error handling written for auth/user-not-found never runs
cause: Email enumeration protection hides whether an address is registered, collapsing sign-in failures into INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS and returning no sign-in methods. It is on by default for projects created on or after September 15, 2023.
fix: Treat auth/invalid-credential as a generic bad email or password message and drop flows that look up sign-in methods by email. Turn protection off only if you accept the enumeration risk.
affected: Firebase Auth projects created on or after 2023-09-15, and older projects where protection was turned on
